definitions.explanation: A brief meeting held at the start of the workday or school day for announcements, coordination, and team alignment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{朝会|ちょうかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a morning meeting every day.

examples.japanese: {朝会|ちょうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: We confirm today's schedule at the morning meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{朝会|ちょうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{全校生徒|ぜんこうせいと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The principal spoke to all the students at the morning assembly.

notes:
Used in both school and workplace settings. In schools, {朝会|ちょうかい} (also called {全校朝会|ぜんこうちょうかい}) is a regular assembly where the principal addresses students. In companies, it refers to a short daily stand-up meeting at the start of work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝会|ちょうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a morning meeting
- ⟦{全校|ぜんこう}→全校：28166_zenkou⟧{朝会|ちょうかい}: schoolwide morning assembly
- {朝会|ちょうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to make an announcement at the morning meeting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朝礼|ちょうれい}→朝礼：16381_chourei⟧: morning assembly — very similar; ⟦{朝礼|ちょうれい}→朝礼：16381_chourei⟧ is more commonly used in corporate settings and may include a more formal structure
- ⟦{終礼|しゅうれい}→終礼：23186_shuurei⟧: end-of-day meeting — the counterpart held at the end of the workday
- ⟦ミーティング→ミーティング：05506_miitingu⟧: meeting — a general loanword for any kind of meeting
